name: Tamil Traditional Handicrafts Ad (9:16)
description: Heritage product ad in Tamil celebrating handloom weavers and terracotta artisans.

brief.goal: Showcase artisanal hand-woven sarees and terracotta pottery
brief.story: Hands weaving silk threads on a wooden loom; clay shaped on the pottery wheel; vibrant festive showcase of finished artisanal crafts.
brief.audience: Heritage craft lovers and festive shoppers
brief.setting: Heritage Chettinad courtyard workshop with sunbeams
